name: Summit County, OH
findings: Summit County has 2,245 nonprofit organizations. 864 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 674 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Summit County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 180 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 180 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few political organizations list volunteering
observations.text: 5 political organizations here list volunteering. In similar places of this size, about 11 would.

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for ways to volunteer through political groups? Where else does that happen?
